description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Switch Draw Mode II (Ice, Dark)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Laguna Mania Mode I: Kiros v2], [(Dark/Ice) Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Laguna Mania Mode I: Kiros v2
description.text: Dark and Ice abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Dark and Ice abilities trigger 2 additional times, casts Dual Turbulent Slash after using Dark or Ice abilities (max 3)

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Laguna Mania Mode II: Kiros v2] to the user

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Laguna Mania Mode II: Kiros v2
description.text: Dark and Ice abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, instant cast speed for Dark and Ice abilities, casts Dual Boring Life after using Dark or Ice ability

description.name: Dual Boring Life
description.text: Causes [Imperil Dark 20% (15s)] and [Imperil Ice 20% (15s)] to the taget and grants [Quick Cast 2] to the user if there are 0-3 Ninja allies in the party, Causes [Imperil Prismatic 20% (15s)] to the target and grants [Instant Cast 2] to the user if there are 4+ Ninja allies in the party

description.name: Imperil Prismatic 20% (15s)
description.text: Causes [Imperil Fire 20% (15s)], [Imperil Ice 20% (15s)], [Imperil Lightning 20% (15s)], [Imperil Earth 20% (15s)], [Imperil Wind 20% (15s)], [Imperil Water 20% (15s)], [Imperil Holy 20% (15s)], [Imperil Dark 20% (15s)] and [Imperil Poison 20% (15s)]

description.name: Dual Turbulent Slash
description.text: 5/6/7 single attacks (0.32 each) after using 1/2/3 Dark or Ice abilities
